scenario: Money: an agency rate card asks about paid usage and a Spark code, and adds an exclusivity clause (Block 3)
subject: Re: Lola x Quillmoss - Holiday Glow?

messages.body:
Hi Lola,

Your June GRWM with our PR box was lovely - 112k views on a post we didn't even ask for.

We're booking creators for Holiday Glow (Nov 16 - Dec 6), featuring Veil Skin Tint SPF 30, and we'd love to have you for a paid TikTok. Would you be open to it? If so, send me your rate and your audience split and I'll put a booking together.

Thanks so much,
Imogen
messages.subject: Lola x Quillmoss - Holiday Glow?

messages.body:
Hi Imogen,

Thanks for reaching out to Lola - I look after her brand partnerships at Brightline Talent, so I'll take it from here (Lola cc'd).

Lola loved the PR box and is keen. Her current rate card:

- TikTok video (60-90s): 3,800 USD
- Instagram Reel: 3,400 USD
- Story set (3 frames): 1,200 USD

Organic repost on your channels is included. Lola's median TikTok views are around 85k, with 64% of her audience in the US.

Two questions before we send paperwork:

1. What would you pay on top for 90-day paid usage on the TikTok?
2. Would you want a Spark Ads code? Our standard is 30 days included with paid usage, longer codes on request.

Please also note that all of Lola's paid partnerships carry our standard 60-day category exclusivity (skincare and SPF), at 25% of the total fee.

We'd want to lock dates by Oct 16. Looking forward to working together.

Best,
Harriet Cole
Senior Talent Manager, Brightline Talent
